scope: Targeted normalization location/consumer comparison; not exhaustive novelty.

matches.hypothesis: Native query-language cross-attention computes a LayerNorm result but discards it before query self-attention. Its affine parameters therefore cannot learn language-conditioned query calibration. Reconnecting only the existing qla postnorm may remove residual common-mode/scale nuisance and restore a task-loss gradient path; this is a falsifiable implementation mechanism, not a promised accuracy improvement.
matches.matched_control: Frozen first64 distinct TRAIN scenes in dataset order, at most4 descriptions, seed1999, identical cached native decoder inputs and W2 checkpoint. Compare native/repeat/identity-return hook, existing qla LayerNorm reconnected, and unit-RMS-only normalization. First8 trained and first4 released-initialization native backward batches compare connected versus detached affine parameters at identical forward values. No padding/token subset, threshold, temperature, loss-weight or validation scan.

matches.hypothesis: Independent normalization of boundary/interior visual messages may discard boundary probability mass.
matches.matched_control: Physical W2/Y36, fixed query/coordinates/mass, constant visual features and equal mask histogram; block versus alternating probability assignment.

matches.hypothesis: One output LayerNorm affine transform is reused for initial and six refined mask/score readouts although their query distributions differ. Independent per-stage affine readout normalization may reduce shared mask/score-gradient interference. This is an architectural allocation test; existing stage layers can implicitly compensate and benefit is unknown.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 native YAML, seven shared confidence-indicator calls and all native losses. Copy the existing out_norm into six private refinement LayerNorms without RNG, retaining stage0 out_norm. Only prediction_head affine sharing changes; Q128/seed1999/fixed30/released SPFormer/selector/Boolean attention gate remain unchanged. +3072 parameters.

matches.hypothesis: Native mask features x_mask(x) are expression-independent before their dot product with language-conditioned queries. A direct valid-language-conditioned channel modulation of the shared mask features may make conditional mask fitting easier. Existing query cross-attention can represent language interactions; this is an architectural comparison, not a missing-information, novelty or efficacy claim.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus one mask-feature multiplication after native get_batches: f_next=f*(1+tanh(mean_valid(projected_language)@W)); W[256,256] exact zero/no RNG, +65536 parameters. Same modulated tensor feeds all seven native prediction heads. No change to shared confidence head, targets, losses, Boolean attention gate, selector, all-channel input, released SPFormer, seed1999, Q128 or fixed30 native YAML.

matches.hypothesis: Native W2 adds projected sparse-3D and existing 2D appearance features before sum_norm. An explicit learned channel-product residual before that same normalization may ease visual interaction fitting. Existing downstream attention/MLPs may represent such interactions; neither missing information, novelty nor efficacy is presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus fused=s+a+(s*a)@W for native projected spatial/appearance features; W[256,256] exact zero/no RNG (+65536 parameters), one call before original sum_norm. Original all-channel inputs and existing 2D features, mask features, query sampling, coarse/fine equal fusion, hard masks/SCG/k/gamma, seven shared confidence calls/targets/losses/selector, released SPFormer, Q128/seed1999/fixed30 and native YAML are preserved. At zero, all parent weights/RNG/decoder outputs/input gradients anchor to W2.

matches.hypothesis: W2 refines visual instance states with language at every decoder stage but predicts all masks against the same static x_mask features. A shared zero-initialized residual from the current refined visual state into each later mask feature tensor may ease conditional mask fitting. Queries already carry contextual information; missing information, novelty and efficacy are not presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus mask_features_i=mask_features+clean(refined_visual_i)@W before the six loop prediction heads; W[256,256] exact zero/no RNG (+65536 parameters), padded rows zeroed, stage0 unchanged. Each call consumes current original ila_ffn output without accumulating previous residuals. Original shared confidence heads/targets/losses, mask-to-attention hard-gate algorithm, original SCG/k/gamma, query sampling, equal coarse/fine fusion, static x_mask, full inputs/existing2D data, released SPFormer, Q128/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML remain unchanged.

matches.hypothesis: Native W2 predicts refined masks from each current query against expression-independent static mask features. A shared attention residual from the full current refined query set into each later mask feature tensor may ease instance-conditioned mask fitting. Existing language/query paths can carry equivalent context; missing information, novelty and trained efficacy are not presumed.
matches.matched_control: Independent unchanged W2 plus mask_features_i=mask_base+clean((softmax(mask_base@current_refined_queries.T/sqrt(d))@current_refined_queries)@W), shared W[256,256] exactly zero/no RNG (+65536). Six calls before original loop prediction heads; original initial prediction unchanged, original static mask base reused without accumulating updates, padded residual rows zero. All128 queries and all channels retained and undetached. Original sampling/geometry/coarse-fine equal fusion/Boolean gate algorithm/SCG/k/gamma, seven shared confidence heads/targets/losses/argmax, all inputs/existing2D/released backbone/Q128/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML remain. Fixed standard sqrt(d) scaling only; no temperature/threshold/loss/feature/epoch/validation search.

matches.hypothesis: The active norm_qqa affine transform is shared across six recurrent self/language query fusion updates. Independent per-stage copies with identical LayerNorm statistics/epsilon may ease stage-specific representation fitting. Existing stage FFNs can compensate; trained efficacy, missing information and novelty are not presumed.
matches.matched_control: Independent unchanged W2. Keep original norm_qqa at refinement stage0 and copy it without RNG into five private refinement_query_norms for stages1..5 (+2560). Only affine parameter sharing in LayerNorm(query_self+query_qla) changes. Initial state and all seven mask/score/confidence predictions match W2; native eps/dtype/full query channels/Q128, shared out_norm/confidence MLP, static mask, initial prediction, hard attention algorithm/sampling/SCG/k/gamma/geometry, original full input/existing2D/released backbone/targets/loss/selector/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML remain. No scans of parameters or validation-selected schedules/features/thresholds/losses.

matches.hypothesis: Native initial queries use sampled local visual states before six refinements. A direct learned projection of point-mass-weighted mean scene visual features into initial queries may ease global-context fitting. Later cross-attention already provides global information; no missing information, novelty or efficacy is presumed.
matches.matched_control: Independent unchanged W2 plus q_init=q_generated+weighted_mean(all valid original inst_feats, point_mass)@W once before initial prediction. Shared zero W256x256/no RNG/+65536. Use all256 channels and all valid original superpoints/masses; masked or zero-total support contributes zero. Preserve all original coordinates/sampling/SCG/k/gamma/hard gates/static masks/full input/existing2D/released backbone/shared confidence/targets/loss/selector/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML. No validation scans.
